meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用 CDP 协议控制 Chrome 浏览器，复用登录态完成自动化操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制 Chrome 浏览器并复用已有登录会话
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to automate browser tasks with existing login sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control Chrome and reuse existing login sessions

howto.what: Claude 可以通过 CDP 协议控制你的 Chrome 浏览器，执行打开网页、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、截图、提取认证令牌等操作，并复用你已有的登录会话。注意：首次使用时会关闭当前运行的 Chrome 并需你同意。
howto.when: 当你提到“浏览器操作”、“CDP”、“Chrome CDP”等关键词，或要求控制 Chrome 浏览器进行自动化操作时触发。

say.text: 打开百度首页，并截取完整页面。
say.note: Claude 会启动 Chrome 并执行操作。

say.text: 提取当前登录网站的 token 信息。
点击页面 id 为 'submit' 的按钮。
say.note: Claude 会使用 snapshot 找到元素并点击。

howto.what_en: Claude can control your Chrome browser via CDP, performing actions like opening URLs, waiting for page load, executing JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens, reusing existing login sessions. Note: first use will kill your running Chrome and requires your consent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phrases like 'browser operation', 'CDP', 'Chrome CDP', or ask to automate a Chrome browser.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and take a full page screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will launch Chrome and execute the task.

say_en.text: Extract the auth token from the current website.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve it via CDP from localStorage or cookies.

say_en.text: Click the button with id 'submit' on the page.
say_en.note: Claude will use snapshot to locate and click the element.
